\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Normal variation of geodesic between submanifolds] 1. ch10:10-9

Suppose $(M,g)$ is a Riemannian manifold and $M_1, M_2 \subseteq M$ are embedded submanifolds. Let $\gamma : [a,b] \to M$ be a unit-speed geodesic segment that meets $M_1$ orthogonally at $t = a$ and meets $M_2$ orthogonally at $t = b$, and let $\Gamma : K \times [a,b] \to M$ be a normal variation of $\gamma $ such that $\Gamma (s,a) \in M_1$ and $\Gamma (s,b) \in M_2$ for all $s$. Prove the following generalization of the second variation formula: \[ \frac{d^2}{ds^2}\bigg|_{s=0} L_g(\Gamma _s) = \int _a^b \left(|D_t V|^2 - Rm(V, y', y', V)\right) dt + [\Pi _2(V(b), V(b)), y'(b)] - [\Pi _1(V(a), V(a)), y'(a)], \] where $V$ is the variation field of $\Gamma $, and $\Pi _i$ is the second fundamental form of $M_i$ for $i = 1, 2$. (Used on p. 365.) \end{exercise}
